title:
Stage 1 forge tier — increment 2e ONLY: forge goal --proof / forge fill UX + burn receipts (REQ-7). Authoritative spec: .design/stage1-forge-tier.md REQ-7 + AC-11; sequencing in .design/stage1-forge-tier-kickoff-plan.md. Builds on merged predecessors: foundation (#20, CertVerdict + schema-v2 cert), 2a (#29, ?pN proof holes + proof addresses f.proof.ens#k / ?pN), 2b (#42), 2c (#43, the battery), 2d (#44, anti-Goodhart re-elaboration). Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop; commit per coherent sub-unit; self-verify before each commit; revert anything that fails. CRITICAL self-verify (the standing lesson): run python3 tooling/doc-drift.py and RE-PIN the audited-sha of EVERY design doc whose governed source you touch, and run req-registry.py --check; finish 0-drift. If low on time or budget, STOP at a sub-unit boundary and report what landed.

SCOPE: REQ-7 ONLY. OUT OF SCOPE: relax engine (2f, REQ-8b), lemma library (3, REQ-9). REQ-3/4/5/6 are DONE — consume, do not redo.

DELIVERABLES:
1. forge goal --proof: the goal REPL (forge/src/goal_repl.rs) grows a PROOF VIEW — a forge-routed goal rendered with its HYPOTHESES IN SCOPE (this needs elaborator context — extract the in-scope hypotheses from the Lean discharge path; there is no hypothesis extraction today, so this is the new piece). cli.rs gains the --proof flag on forge goal.
2. forge fill <item> ?pN "<tactics>": fill_hole accepts the ?pN proof-hole addresses from 2a (not just body ?N), closes the goal end to end, and re-checks. The tactics are subject to 2c's frozen battery (cite-unlisted → refused).
3. Burn receipts in the certificate, per the RFC-1 §9 L3 certificate shape and the RESOLVED Q-BURN: burn.proof_tokens = the lexer-token count of the committed proof text (deterministic, re-derivable); an optional burn.authoring_tokens (LLM tokens, absent unless the authoring harness supplies them) + cited lemmas. BOTH burn fields are ORACLE-EXCLUDED per Q-BURN (re-authoring a proof legitimately changes them) — so they must NOT enter manifest.rs oracle_subset, and the v1 golden certs stay byte-identical.

GAUNTLET before each commit: cargo test -p forge; clippy -p forge --all-targets -- -D warnings; fmt --check; for any Lean touch, lake build + axiom probe; doc-drift 0-drift (re-pin touched docs); req-registry --check clean; forge check over conformance still matches all v1 golden certs with oracle_subset byte-identical. AC-11 specifically: forge goal --proof renders hypotheses for a forge-routed goal; forge fill <item> ?p0 "<tactics>" closes a goal end to end on the merge example; the resulting certificate contains the burn receipt (token count + cited lemmas). The hypothesis-extraction + fill paths are Lean-discharge work — verify what you can locally; the local env cannot clone lean-smt so some engine::tests Lean-spine cases skip locally (expected, NOT a regression); the CI lean job is the authoritative gate. No stubs/TODOs.

REGISTRY: register REQ-7 as REQ-S1-7 (shipped) with typed evidence; regenerate the status view; req-registry.py --check clean. No hand-written ## REQ status table.

SCOPE GUARDS: no cage / combinator-menu change; the burn receipt is oracle-EXCLUDED (do not add it to oracle_subset); do NOT flip the README/docs headline (G1 gate only, R-GATE-1); never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json or .claude/settings.json. NOTE: git push is blocked for you by policy — commit locally, end with a clear summary, and the orchestrator pushes + opens the PR. One branch; ONE increment (2e).
